description: An IT Technical Writer for IT services and application development is responsible for creating technical documentation, such as job aids, help documents, user guides, reference manuals, training materials, online help content, etc. These documents facilitate the transfer of knowledge between application development teams and user teams. They collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather information, utilize documentation tools, and ensure consistency with industry standards. Additionally, they format and publish content across multiple platforms, maintaining and updating documents to reflect changes in products or services.
